Grace / Karthik — forwarding Samir's note and Grace's quick reply. A few legal points I want to raise before we send a proposed exhibit back to MedCura:

1) "Reasonable notice" vs fixed days: Samir called out 10 business days. Legal preference is to keep a fixed notice window in the exhibit (10 business days) but add an emergency carve-out for incident-driven inspections with mutually agreed narrow scope.

2) Scope definition: we should add an Appendix A that enumerates allowed activities for pen tests (no destructive tests, no social engineering, no insider attacks). Keeps the main MSA high-level and gives ops detailed constraints.

3) Sampling bands & evidence: Laura suggests "sampling bands" language: sample sizes by class (logs, configs, user access lists) and a maximum of 2 privileged inspection sessions per 12 months without additional approval. This helps limit operational burden.

4) Audit report redaction: we should allow reasonable redaction for PII and third-party vendor info and require an attestation that redactions do not mask systemic issues.

I'll draft suggested exhibit text and an Appendix A for allowed pen-test activities. Karthik — can you confirm whether your infra team is comfortable with a 14-day staging window and the quarterly -> bi-annual cadence operationally?

- Laura
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks — infra is OK with the proposed operational windows with the following clarifications from ops:

- Staging window: 14 calendar days, credentialed access, vulnerability scans only (no active exploitation), and a short remediation verification window of 7 days post-scan where Redwood can validate fixes in staging.
- Live window: 10 business days notice required; live testing limited to non-destructive validation (auth bypass checks, rate limits, etc.).
- Privileged inspection sessions: limit of 2 per year as Laura suggested; additional sessions require SOC lead approval and a scoped Statement of Work (SOW).
- Evidence delivery: we'll create an "evidence matrix" (see attached evidence-matrix.xlsx) that maps artifacts to SOC 2 assertions and the cadence (quarterly -> biannual). Delivery will be via a secure share and under the terms of the NDA.

If legal can draft the Appendix A with enumerated allowed activities, infra can review and sign off.

- Karthik
Director, Customer Engineering
